name: Frappe Books
hook: Modern desktop accounting — free, offline-first, no subscription.
bullets: Double-entry accounting with invoicing, payments, and journal entries
Offline-first desktop app — your data stays on your machine
Financial reports: General Ledger, P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance
setupSteps: Download Frappe Books from the releases page or frappe.io/books
Install on Windows, macOS, or Linux (also available via Homebrew and Flatpak)
Open the app and create a new company file
Set up your chart of accounts and start invoicing
details: Frappe Books is a free, open-source desktop accounting application built with Vue.js and Electron. It uses a local SQLite database, so all your financial data stays on your machine — no cloud required. Features include double-entry accounting, invoicing with a powerful template builder, billing, payments, journal entries, and comprehensive financial reports (General Ledger, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance). The UI is fast and modern with fuzzy search (Ctrl+K) for quick navigation. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.
setup: Install the desktop app, no server needed
